welcome.message: Search a species in the card above to see its IUCN range, its GBIF records and how much of its range is protected. The settings and charts follow the species you choose, and you can ask about it here.
examples: How much of the jaguar's range is strictly protected?
Which threatened amphibians share most of this species' range?
Which countries hold most of this species' GBIF records, and how does that compare with its IUCN range?

charts.title: Range in protected areas by IUCN management category
charts.sql:
WITH idx AS (SELECT id_no, sci_name, h0 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-iucn/iucn-ranges-2025/species-h0-index.parquet')),
ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT id_no FROM idx WHERE sci_name IN (SELECT sci_name FROM idx WHERE id_no = {{SPECIES}})),
h0s AS (SELECT DISTINCT h0 FROM idx WHERE id_no IN (SELECT id_no FROM ids)),
src AS (SELECT native_res, h8, h6, h5 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-iucn/iucn-ranges-2025/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet', hive_partitioning = true) WHERE h0 IN (SELECT h0 FROM h0s) AND id_no IN (SELECT id_no FROM ids) AND presence IN ({{PRESENCE}}) AND origin IN (1, 2)),
nr AS (SELECT CASE WHEN min(native_res) >= 8 THEN 8 WHEN min(native_res) >= 6 THEN 6 ELSE 5 END AS r FROM src),
rng AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE (SELECT r FROM nr) WHEN 8 THEN h8 WHEN 6 THEN h6 ELSE h5 END AS cell FROM src),
pa AS (SELECT h8, min(CASE IUCN_CAT WHEN 'Ia' THEN 1 WHEN 'Ib' THEN 2 WHEN 'II' THEN 3 WHEN 'III' THEN 4 WHEN 'IV' THEN 5 WHEN 'V' THEN 6 WHEN 'VI' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END) AS k FROM read_parquet('s3://public-wdpa/wdpa/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet', hive_partitioning = true) WHERE h0 IN (SELECT h0 FROM h0s) AND STATUS <> 'Proposed' AND DESIG_ENG <> 'UNESCO-MAB Biosphere Reserve' AND h3_cell_to_parent(h8, (SELECT r FROM nr)) IN (SELECT cell FROM rng) GROUP BY h8),
oe AS (SELECT DISTINCT h8, 9 AS k FROM read_parquet('s3://public-wdpa/wdoecm-may-2026/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet', hive_partitioning = true) WHERE {{OECM}} = 1 AND h0 IN (SELECT h0 FROM h0s) AND h3_cell_to_parent(h8, (SELECT r FROM nr)) IN (SELECT cell FROM rng) AND h8 NOT IN (SELECT h8 FROM pa)),
tot AS (SELECT count(*) * pow(7, 8 - (SELECT r FROM nr)) AS n FROM rng),
cls AS (SELECT k FROM pa UNION ALL SELECT k FROM oe)
SELECT CASE k WHEN 1 THEN 'Ia strict nature reserve' WHEN 2 THEN 'Ib wilderness area' WHEN 3 THEN 'II national park' WHEN 4 THEN 'III natural monument' WHEN 5 THEN 'IV habitat or species management area' WHEN 6 THEN 'V protected landscape or seascape' WHEN 7 THEN 'VI sustainable use area' WHEN 8 THEN 'No IUCN category' ELSE 'OECM' END AS category, count(*) / (SELECT n FROM tot) AS share FROM cls GROUP BY k ORDER BY k

charts.title: GBIF records by decade
charts.sql: SELECT (("year" // 10) * 10)::VARCHAR || 's' AS decade, count(*) AS records FROM read_parquet('s3://public-gbif/2026-09/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet', hive_partitioning = true) WHERE h0 IN (SELECT h0 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-gbif/2026-09/species-h0-index.parquet') WHERE species = '{{SPECIES_NAME}}') AND species = '{{SPECIES_NAME}}' AND NOT list_has_any(issue, ['ZERO_COORDINATE', 'COORDINATE_INVALID', 'COORDINATE_OUT_OF_RANGE', 'COUNTRY_COORDINATE_MISMATCH']) AND coalesce(occurrencestatus, 'PRESENT') <> 'ABSENT' AND basisofrecord NOT IN ('FOSSIL_SPECIMEN', 'LIVING_SPECIMEN') AND "year" IS NOT NULL AND "year" >= {{SINCE}} GROUP BY "year" // 10 ORDER BY "year" // 10

charts.title: GBIF records by country
charts.sql: SELECT coalesce(countrycode, 'Unknown') AS country, count(*) AS records FROM read_parquet('s3://public-gbif/2026-09/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet', hive_partitioning = true) WHERE h0 IN (SELECT h0 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-gbif/2026-09/species-h0-index.parquet') WHERE species = '{{SPECIES_NAME}}') AND species = '{{SPECIES_NAME}}' AND NOT list_has_any(issue, ['ZERO_COORDINATE', 'COORDINATE_INVALID', 'COORDINATE_OUT_OF_RANGE', 'COUNTRY_COORDINATE_MISMATCH']) AND coalesce(occurrencestatus, 'PRESENT') <> 'ABSENT' AND basisofrecord NOT IN ('FOSSIL_SPECIMEN', 'LIVING_SPECIMEN') AND "year" IS NOT NULL AND "year" >= {{SINCE}} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12
